inspection.parser: TypeScript 5.9.3 source parser; no emission or execution

typescript-loader.finding: The default .ts loader enables TypeScript parsing. The production builder only overrides .wasm.

static-record-index.finding: Whole import type declarations return before record creation; ordinary static imports append a record at the current length. Dynamic/require records are added during the later visit pass.

inline-type-specifier-omission.finding: Explicit inline type specifiers are parsed without appending runtime clause items; an all-type clause retains an empty Items pointer before later culling.

type-syntax-omission.finding: Type-reference identifiers and typeof type queries are consumed by type-skipping code, without producing runtime symbol usages.

satisfies-type-omission.finding: The type operand of as/satisfies is skipped as TypeScript syntax.

typescript-unused-import-elision.finding: In TS mode with zero preservation flags, an existing named clause sets foundImports even when empty. With no value-syntax usages, isUnusedInTypeScript remains true, the import is marked IsUnused and its statement is omitted.

unused-record-metadata.finding: IsUnused records skip resolution. Input metadata still iterates the original record array and writes external:true for nil resolution results, preserving the metadata array index.

zero-preservation-flags.finding: UnusedImportFlags defaults to zero unless verbatimModuleSyntax, preserveValueImports, or importsNotUsedAsValues preservation is selected.

caveats: Quoted occurrences are disambiguated by static import-record creation order, excluding whole import type declarations.
Binding occurrence inspection is conservative name-based AST inspection; every same-spelling identifier outside its import is recorded, including potential shadowed names.
These are discarded import records, not globally absent target modules. Other imports from the same source target may contribute bundled code.
Exact target absence from all output import paths is established by the complete hosted diagnostic association; this inspection does not rerun the builder.
No runtime code, build, native add-on, or provider was executed by this classification.
The separate unresolved optional pg-native require remains in the bundled output graph; this classification does not prove branch inactivity.
